scripts.dev: corepack pnpm run build:shared && corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @vhos/api --filter @vhos/web dev
scripts.db:migrate: corepack pnpm --filter @vhos/api exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: corepack pnpm --filter @vhos/api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: corepack pnpm --filter @vhos/api exec prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: corepack pnpm run db:deploy && corepack pnpm run db:seed
